description: Add new ads. Each must include AdGroupId and an ad-type-specific object (TextAd, DynamicTextAd, etc.). Use when the user asks to create ads in an ad group. Do not use it to rewrite an existing ad; call update_ads. Do not use it to list ads; call get_ads.

items_json.description: JSON array of ad objects, e.g. [{"AdGroupId":67890,"TextAd":{"Title":"My Ad","Title2":"Subtitle","Text":"Ad body text","Href":"https://example.com","Mobile":"NO"}}]

name: add_ads
